title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Liani Greaves and Barry Jenkins on Once Upon a Time in Harlem
excerpt_original: The producer (and William Greaves’s granddaughter) speaks with the filmmaker about the newly resurrected portrait of the Harlem Renaissance

blocks.text: For this week’s episode, Film Comment Editor Devika Girish spoke with Liani Greaves and filmmaker Barry Jenkins about the making and significance of the film and the immense and unparalleled legacy of the late, great William Greaves.
